item.title: St. Francisville man killed after truck crashes, catches fire in West Feliciana Parish
item.description: Jason Freeman, 49, of St. Francisville, Louisiana, was killed in a single-vehicle crash on LA 10 near LA 965 in West Feliciana Parish on Wednesday morning after failing to negotiate a curve and hitting a tree.

item.title: Chia seeds sold by Amazon, Whole Foods recalled over salmonella risk
item.description: A "superfood" sold nationwide is under recall over the risk of salmonella contamination.

item.title: Garrett Nussmeier opens up about injury that sidelined him at LSU, Senior Bowl training
item.description: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier is attempting to show NFL teams he is healthy at the Senior Bowl in Mobile, Alabama after suffering a core/abdominal injury that ended his season.

item.title: Longtime Donaldsonville restaurant Grapevine Café featured during Restaurant Week
item.description: The Grapevine Café, a local staple known for its Louisiana-inspired dishes and welcoming atmosphere, has been serving meals from the heart for nearly three decades and continues to thrive by treating every customer like family.

item.title: 'I'm extremely blessed to have him in my life': How the Nussmeiers are approaching the Senior Bowl
item.description: The New Orleans Saints are getting a first-hand look this week at some of the top prospects in this year’s NFL Draft at the Senior Bowl in Mobile, Ala. There’s one player they’re already pretty familiar with, LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier.

item.title: The Krewe of Centaur host The Art of Mardi Gras, a 72-Hour Celebration
item.description: The Krewe of Centaur is hosting a 72-Hour Mardi Gras Celebration in Shreveport, Louisiana from February 5-7, 2026, featuring a black-tie Grand Bal, a family-friendly Float Loading Party, and a grand parade.

item.title: Baton Rouge Weather: Warmer temperatures for tomorrow
item.description: BATON ROUGE, La. (Louisiana First) — The StormTracker team is watching another arctic blast of cold air that will arrive just in time for the weekend. TONIGHT: Overnight lows are likely to fall to the upper 20s and lower 30s. Skies will remain mostly clear with light to calm winds out of the North. [...]

item.title: District 6 Councilman Cleve Dunn Jr. indicted in Baton Rouge corruption probe
item.description: Cleve Dunn Jr., a Baton Rouge council member representing District 6, was indicted on multiple charges, including theft and money laundering, inside a Baton Rouge courtroom on Wednesday morning, The Advocate reports.

item.title: Baton Rouge middle school counselor accused of texting minor found dead on Wednesday, officials confirm
item.description: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office confirmed a body was found inside an abandoned school on Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Authorities investigate deadly shooting in Baton Rouge Wednesday night
item.description: Authorities are investigating a deadly shooting on Wednesday evening.
